Install and publish.

  1. 01
    Close the editor and unzip into your project, so you have <Project>/Plugins/VersePublish/VersePublish.uplugin.The Plugins folder sits next to your .uproject.
  2. 02
    Open the project and accept the prompt to rebuild the module.A Tools › Verse menu appears.
  3. 03
    Optional: paste an account token from Studio in Project Settings › Plugins › Verse Publish.Your scenes become permanent and are listed in your library.
  4. 04
    Open Tools › Verse › Publish to Verse and press Publish to Verse.Upload %, then the build stages, then the link — copied for you.

Publish from Unreal Engine→

WHAT GETS PUBLISHED

  • The level (or the selected actors) as one scene
  • Unreal materials and lighting, baked on publish
  • Textures at source resolution — nothing downscaled

Big projects.

Up to 20 GB, sent in resumable parts. Browser uploads stop at 500 MB.
